title: fix(cli): correct generation command help
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
- Correct the text stdin example to `echo 'hello' | polli gen text`.
- Describe the video's omitted model as the API default, matching the existing chat help. Remove the promise of an unsupported config default without changing generation behavior.
- Keep both generation-help corrections together; bump CLI to `0.1.27` with its standalone lockfile.
- Validation: all 292 CLI tests, build, changed-file Biome checks and built CLI help checks pass. Standalone TypeScript checking reports the same 36 baseline errors with byte-identical diagnostics; no new diagnostics.

Fixes #16468

gist.headline: Help text finds its footing
gist.blurb: The CLI’s generation help gets its instructions straight: text has a working stdin example, and video points to the API default instead of an imaginary config setting.
gist.summary: Corrects the text stdin example to `echo 'hello' | polli gen text` and clarifies that an omitted video model uses the API default, without changing generation behavior.
gist.impact: CLI users get a working text command to copy and accurate guidance on video model selection.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli tidying two help cards beside a retro terminal: one shows the text stdin command, while the other connects a video icon to an API-default sign. Small code-plants make the scene feel like a friendly workspace; the cards represent corrected instructions, not changed generation behavior.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli straightens two help cards beside a retro terminal and a small code-plant: one card reads `echo 'hello' | polli gen text`, while a video-icon card reads `API DEFAULT`. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny librarian glasses, stays small within the scene, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), a warm cream background, dark purple (#110518) lettering, chunky sprites, and a nostalgic, emotionally warm feel.
